examples.question: Сколько всего заказов?
examples.sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders_count FROM orders

examples.question: Выручка по регионам клиентов за 2025 год
examples.sql:
SELECT r.name AS region, sum(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id
JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY r.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC

examples.question: Топ-10 товаров по проданным единицам
examples.sql:
SELECT p.name AS product, sum(i.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10

examples.question: Средний чек по каналам продаж
examples.sql:
SELECT o.channel, round(avg(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_check
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY o.channel
ORDER BY avg_check DESC

examples.question: Выручка по месяцам за 2026 год
examples.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', o.created_at)::date AS month, sum(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

examples.question: Выручка за финансовый квартал FQ1 2026 года
examples.sql:
SELECT sum(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN fiscal_calendar f ON f.date = o.created_at::date
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND f.fiscal_year = 2026 AND f.fiscal_quarter = 1

examples.question: Сумма оплат за прошлый календарный квартал
examples.sql:
SELECT sum(p.amount) AS paid_amount
FROM payments p
WHERE p.paid_at >= date_trunc('quarter', now()) - interval '3 months'
  AND p.paid_at < date_trunc('quarter', now())

examples.question: Топ-5 менеджеров по выручке в 2025 году
examples.sql:
SELECT m.full_name AS manager, sum(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN managers m ON m.id = o.manager_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY m.full_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

examples.question: Сколько клиентов ни разу не делали заказ?
examples.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS customers_without_orders
FROM customers c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)

examples.question: Сумма возвратов по причинам
examples.sql:
SELECT r.reason, count(*) AS returns_count, sum(r.amount) AS refunded
FROM returns r
GROUP BY r.reason
ORDER BY refunded DESC

examples.question: Выручка по категориям товаров за 2025 год
examples.sql:
SELECT cat.name AS category, sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id
JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY cat.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC

examples.question: Доля онлайн-заказов
examples.sql:
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.channel = 'online') / count(*), 2) AS online_share_pct
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'

examples.question: Сколько заказов в Алматинской области по месту жительства клиента?
examples.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS orders_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id
JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND r.name = 'Алматинская область'

examples.question: Популярность способов оплаты
examples.sql:
SELECT p.method, count(*) AS payments_count, sum(p.amount) AS amount
FROM payments p
GROUP BY p.method
ORDER BY payments_count DESC

examples.question: Чистая выручка за 2025 год с учётом возвратов
examples.sql:
WITH sales AS (
  SELECT sum(o.total_amount) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-01'
), refunds AS (
  SELECT sum(r.amount) AS refunded
  FROM returns r
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id
  WHERE o.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT s.revenue, rf.refunded, s.revenue - coalesce(rf.refunded, 0) AS net_revenue
FROM sales s CROSS JOIN refunds rf

examples.question: Сколько новых клиентов регистрировалось каждый месяц в 2026 году?
examples.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', c.registered_at)::date AS month, count(*) AS new_customers
FROM customers c
WHERE c.registered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND c.registered_at < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

examples.question: Средняя наценка по категориям
examples.sql:
SELECT cat.name AS category, round(avg(p.price - p.cost), 2) AS avg_markup
FROM products p
JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id
GROUP BY cat.name
ORDER BY avg_markup DESC

examples.question: Сколько работающих менеджеров в каждом регионе?
examples.sql:
SELECT r.name AS region, count(*) AS managers_count
FROM managers m
JOIN regions r ON r.id = m.region_id
WHERE m.fired_at IS NULL
GROUP BY r.name
ORDER BY managers_count DESC

examples.question: Топ-5 b2b-клиентов по сумме покупок
examples.sql:
SELECT c.full_name AS customer, sum(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND c.segment = 'b2b'
GROUP BY c.full_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

examples.question: Заказы, оплаченные несколькими платежами
examples.sql:
SELECT p.order_id, count(*) AS payments_count, sum(p.amount) AS paid
FROM payments p
GROUP BY p.order_id
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY paid DESC
LIMIT 20
